plan.description:
Plan revision 0, tier graph (molecular dynamics on the graph tier)
  backend hybrid | force float32 | MC energy float32 (pending the move-energy gate) | runner in-process
  rewrites on (19): factor_species, fold_cutoff, density_first, reassociate_first, joint_radial_input,
      fused_folded_backward, folded_backward_tiles, segmented_first_sum, streaming_conv, block_linear, grouped_linear,
      merged_residual, gated_rows, segment_gemm, single_graph_strain, species_tables, fold_readout_tail,
      fold_product_linear, polar_uvu
  rewrites off: fused_radial_hidden, direct_node_feats, folded_constants, combo_kernels,
      tf32x3_gemms (only an explicit 'on' enables it); grouped_launch (not the generic MACE family, decision 57);
      species_skip (not supported by the model); fx_e3nn_linear (+2 more; describe(full=True) lists them)
  sizes: skin 0.92 A, headroom 1.2 (fixed), edge bucket +5 %, multiple 256, re-capture budget 64, variant cap 64
  sizes: D3: no list; k-space headroom n/a
  kernels: OEq yes, Triton yes, NVRTC yes, fused cuEq yes
  memory (rule 12): 1.53 GiB predicted (build; run 1.01, build 1.53), fits (14.80 GiB free); GPU NVIDIA GeForce RTX 506…
  workload: Langevin NVT, fixcm=True; 756 atoms, 3D PBC, no constraints; up to 1000 K; MC swap from 250 K;
      species changes
  rules 8-11: superset O Na Cl Nb (8), max_temperature_K 1000 K (11), host_callbacks_every none (9),
      species_changes on (8), skin 0.92 A (11), headroom fixed (11), recapture_budget 64 (11)
  fallbacks: none
  calibration: none
  revisions: 0 minimal plan (phase 1b)
plan.description_full:
Plan revision 0, tier graph: minimal plan (phase 1b)
  mode = graph  (molecular dynamics on the graph tier (SPEC §8.1))
  allow_reference = off  (not requested)
  superset = O Na Cl Nb  (declared (species=), equal to the structure's)
  force_precision = float32  (the ForceField's precision (SPEC §7.1, §9.2))
  software.oeq = on  (openequivariance is installed (its extension is built when the hybrid model is loaded))
  software.triton = on  (triton 3.8.0 is importable)
  software.nvrtc = on  (NVRTC 13.0 loads through cuda.bindings)
  software.fused_cueq = on  (cuequivariance_ops_torch imports)
  software.mace_imported_first = none  (modules imported before FastMACE could prepare the OEq runtime)
  allow_naive_cueq = off  (not needed: no naive cuEq kernel)
  workload.max_temperature_K = 1000 K  (rule 11 sizes the skin and headroom: skin 0.92 A, headroom 1.2 (fastest of 756 atoms at 1000 K, lightest mass 15.999 u, 1 fs: 0.0285 A per step, 16 steps per rebuild))
  workload.host_callbacks_every = none  (no host callbacks)
  workload.mc_moves = swap  (MC moves are attached through Simulation.run(mc=...) (SPEC §7.6))
  workload.species_changes = on  (graph mode stays allowed; species-dependent rewrites and tables are built for the superset (SPEC §9.3 rule 8, 3-T02))
  workload.needs_per_atom = none  (recorded)
  tier = graph  (the research engine's --engine gpu: CUDA graphs, edge buckets (SPEC §8.1))
  workload = ok  (756 atoms, 3D PBC, no constraints)
  hardware = NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Ti  (compute capability 12.0, 15.9 GiB (recorded only))
  EngineConfig.backend = hybrid  (requested 'hybrid')
  PrecisionConfig.dtype = float32  (requested 'float32': hybrid backend)
  EngineConfig.cueq_conv_fusion = off  (auto (on_for_plain_cueq_unless_reproducible): not applicable: the hybrid fuses its OEq convolution anyway (the research engine records None))
  RewriteConfig.factor_species = on  (auto (on_for_hybrid_graph_engine_if_model_supports): stage 1: hybrid backend; stage 2: supported (ok))
  RewriteConfig.fold_cutoff = on  (auto (on_with_factor_species_if_model_supports): stage 1: on (with factor_species); stage 2: supported (ok))
  RewriteConfig.density_first = on  (auto (on_with_fold_cutoff_if_model_supports): stage 1: on (with fold_cutoff); stage 2: supported (ok))
  RewriteConfig.reassociate_first = on  (auto (on_with_stage1_fold_cutoff_if_model_supports): stage 1: on (with fold_cutoff); stage 2: supported (ok))
  RewriteConfig.joint_radial_input = on  (auto (on_with_fold_cutoff_if_model_supports): stage 1: on (with fold_cutoff); stage 2: supported (ok))
  RewriteConfig.fused_folded_backward = on  (auto (on_with_stage1_fold_cutoff_if_model_supports): stage 1: on (with fold_cutoff); stage 2: supported (ok))
  RewriteConfig.folded_backward_tiles = on  (auto (on_with_fused_folded_backward): stage 1: on (with fused_folded_backward); stage 2: supported (ok))
  RewriteConfig.segmented_first_sum = on  (auto (on_with_reassociate_first_and_sort_receivers): stage 1: on (with reassociate_first and sort_receivers); stage 2: supported (ok))
  RewriteConfig.fused_radial_hidden = off  (auto (never_automatic): off: only an explicit 'on' enables it (no measured gain))
  RewriteConfig.direct_node_feats = off  (auto (never_automatic): off: only an explicit 'on' enables it (OPT3-T05, opt-in))
  RewriteConfig.folded_constants = off  (auto (never_automatic): off: only an explicit 'on' enables it (OPT3-T05, opt-in))
  RewriteConfig.streaming_conv = on  (auto (on_for_hybrid_with_stage1_fold_cutoff_and_sort_receivers_if_model_supports): stage 1: on (with the hybrid backend, fold_cutoff (stage 1) and sort_receivers (a hard requirement: streaming kernels on unsorted edges give wrong results)); stage 2: supported (ok))
  RewriteConfig.block_linear = on  (auto (on_for_hybrid_graph_engine): stage 1: hybrid backend)
  RewriteConfig.grouped_linear = on  (auto (on_with_block_linear): stage 1: on (with block_linear))
  RewriteConfig.merged_residual = on  (auto (on_with_block_linear): stage 1: on (with block_linear))
  RewriteConfig.gated_rows = on  (auto (on_with_merged_residual): stage 1: on (with merged_residual); stage 2: supported (ok))
  RewriteConfig.segment_gemm = on  (auto (on_with_gated_rows_float32_unless_reproducible): stage 1: on (with gated_rows); stage 2: supported (ok))
  RewriteConfig.grouped_launch = off  (auto (on_with_block_linear_float32_unless_reproducible_for_generic_mace_family): stage 1: on (with block_linear); stage 2: off, not the generic MACE family, decision 57 (interactions ['RealAgnosticResidualNonLinearInteractionBlock']))
  RewriteConfig.species_skip = off  (auto (on_with_graph_engine_if_model_supports): stage 1: graph engine, any backend; stage 2: off, not supported by the model (no MACE-MP-0 or density-family interaction))
  RewriteConfig.single_graph_strain = on  (auto (on): process-wide; acts only where stress is computed)
  RewriteConfig.species_tables = on  (auto (on_float32_unless_reproducible_if_model_supports): stage 1: graph engine, any backend; stage 2: supported (ok))
  RewriteConfig.fold_readout_tail = on  (auto (on_with_block_linear_float32_unless_reproducible_if_model_supports): stage 1: on (with block_linear); stage 2: supported (ok))
  RewriteConfig.fold_product_linear = on  (auto (on_with_species_tables_and_block_linear_if_model_supports): stage 1: on (with block_linear and species_tables); stage 2: supported (ok))
  RewriteConfig.combo_kernels = off  (auto (never_automatic): off: only an explicit 'on' enables it (opt-in until its A/B on both GPUs))
  RewriteConfig.tf32x3_gemms = off  (auto (never_automatic): off: only an explicit 'on' enables it (OPT4-T03, accuracy screen))
  RewriteConfig.fx_e3nn_linear = off  (auto (on_for_hybrid_float32_unless_reproducible_for_qualified_polar1_checkpoints): stage 1: hybrid backend; stage 2: off, not a qualified POLAR-1 checkpoint, decision 58 (ScaleShiftMACE; qualified: polar1-s, polar1-m, polar1-l))
  RewriteConfig.polar_graph_sums = off  (auto (on_for_hybrid_float32_unless_reproducible_for_qualified_polar1_checkpoints): stage 1: hybrid backend; stage 2: off, not a qualified POLAR-1 checkpoint, decision 58 (ScaleShiftMACE; qualified: polar1-s, polar1-m, polar1-l))
  NeighbourConfig.sort_receivers = on  (auto (on_for_hybrid_graph_engine): hybrid backend)
  NeighbourConfig.gpu_neighbour_list = on  (auto (on_with_graph_engine): graph engine)
  RewriteConfig.inplace_block_linear = off  (not carried over in 1a (SPEC §6.2: opt-in, slower))
  RewriteConfig.polar_uvu = on  (no effect: not a PolarMACE model)
  PolarConfig.kspace_headroom = n/a  (auto (variable_cell_0_1_else_0): not a PolarMACE model, no long range)
  EngineConfig.expandable_segments = on  (auto (on_for_torch_2_14_unless_alloc_conf_set): PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True before the first CUDA allocation)
  EngineConfig.compile_mode = default  (main.py's --compile-mode)
  EngineConfig.speculative_graph = off  (off unless requested (main.py default))
  EngineConfig.pipelined = on  (auto (on_with_graph_engine_unless_speculative): graph engine)
  EngineConfig.async_output = on  (auto (on_with_graph_engine): graph engine; the run loop's choice)
  capture = on  (CUDA graphs)
  integrator = Langevin  (NVT, fixcm=True (workflow.GPUEngine))
  compute_stress = off  (fixed cell: the graph engine computes no stress)
  IntegratorConfig.fixcm_projection = mass_weighted  (auto (mass_weighted_under_nvt_fixcm_else_ase): MC moves under fixcm: redraw_all draws (3N - 3) kT, the mass-weighted projection holds every species at the target, temperatures over 3N - 3 degrees of freedom (decision 37))
  IntegratorConfig.dof = fastmace  (auto (owner_decision_d2_default): FastMACE's count: 3N - 3 under fixcm, 3(N - n_fixed) with FixAtoms (owner decision D2))
  NeighbourConfig.skin = 0.92 A  (auto (rule_11_skin_from_workload): skin 0.92 A, headroom 1.2 (fastest of 756 atoms at 1000 K, lightest mass 15.999 u, 1 fs: 0.0285 A per step, 16 steps per rebuild))
  NeighbourConfig.headroom = fixed  (auto (rule_11_headroom_from_workload): capacity_headroom 1.2 from the skin, edge_bucket_fraction as given)
  NeighbourConfig.d3_skin = unused  (auto (rule_11_d3_skin_from_workload): no D3 list; 1 A, the floor)
  EngineConfig.recapture_budget = 64  (auto (recapture_budget_from_workload): the graph variant cap (64): past it the run warns, records and the report recommends the compiled tier (3-T04); rule 11 expects at most 9 padded edge buckets inside the capacity)
  PrecisionConfig.mc_energy = float32  (auto (force_precision_if_move_energy_gate_passes_else_float64): pending the move-energy gate: the force precision float32 if it passes, float64 otherwise, while MD forces keep theirs (SPEC §10.4, §12.3, decision 35))
  EngineConfig.dynamic_edges = on  (the edge dimension is dynamic from the first compiled call, so the model compiles once and the padded first capture reuses that graph instead of compiling again; the edges stay padded to buckets (decision 59))
  memory = fits  (rule 12: predicted 1.53 GiB (build; run 1.01, build 1.53) at 30580 edges, 756 atoms, float32 (self-check segment_gemm 1296 MiB, workspace 160 MiB, rewrites' buffers 62 MiB); needs 1.53 of 14.80 GiB free)
  requested: EngineConfig.backend=hybrid, PrecisionConfig.dtype=float32
